channel.title: Agora Updates
channel.description: Updates for Agora, your local personal CRM.

item.title: Agora 1.0.0
item.description:
# Agora 1.0.0
The first release of Agora, a native personal CRM for macOS 14 and later on Apple silicon.
- People profiles with contact details, tags and notes. - Commitments with deadlines, priorities, source conversations and kept / cancelled states. - Separate tracking for promises you made and promises made to you. - A focused overview and searchable conversation timeline. - Outlook for Mac task-pane add-in with explicit email capture and atomic commitment registration. - Standalone local MCP server with ten tools, sharing the same SQLite library. - Portable JSON export and import, and consistent SQLite backups. - Sparkle updates from GitHub Releases, built and published directly from a Mac without GitHub Actions.
Outlook add-in installation requires a supported mailbox and manual sideloading through your Microsoft account. Real mailbox capture has not yet been verified in a signed-in Outlook session.
